title: matter: Add dissector for BLE advertising data
description:
The dissector is based on Matter Specification Version 1.3, section
5.4.2 Announcement by Device. The Service Data payload format is
described in details in section 5.4.2.5.6 Advertising Data.

The specification is available at:
https://csa-iot.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/Matter-1.3-Core-Specification.pdf

notes.body: To be honest I'm not entirely sure whether the `epan/dissectors/packet-bluetooth.c` is the right place for this kind of dissector. I've put it there because the only occurrence of the `dissector_add_string("btcommon.eir_ad.entry.uuid", ...)` was in that file (which also seems a bit unrelated to `packet-bluetooth.c`). There is a dedicated dissector for Matter BTP protocol (communication via GATT characteristics), and since this dissector is also related to Matter, I could merge these two in one file. However, Matter BTP and BLE advertising are two different things (from the dissected protocol point of view). If anyone has some idea for a better location for this BLE Advertisement Service Data dissector I'm all ears.
